final: WITH race_names AS (SELECT races.name, SUM(results.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId GROUP BY races.name), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points FROM race_names) SELECT SUM(race_names.total_points) AS sum_total_points, AVG(race_names.avg_laps) AS avg_per_race_name_laps, AVG(race_names.total_points - threshold.avg_total_points) AS avg_excess_points FROM race_names CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE race_names.total_points > threshold.avg_total_points
